t: This title may be cited as the “Artists’ Rights and Theft Prevention Act of 2005” or the “ART Act”.

fable.w: This section only provides a short title for the Act and establishes no process, decision, or actor. The tempting reading is that the phrase "Artists' Rights" implies outside parties are given rights or a role, but it is merely a proper-noun title. No consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue is created.

opus.w: This section only gives the Act's short title. It does not involve any party outside the federal government in a federal decision. Words like "Artists' Rights" are just part of a name and set up no process for outsiders to take part.
